title: Thorough-Fare
summary: THOROUGH-FARE, noun thur'ro-fare. [thorough and fare.] 1. A passage through; a passage from one street or opening to another; an unobstructed way. 2. Power of passing.

inlines.v: THOROUGH-FARE, noun thur'ro-fare. [thorough and fare.] 1. A passage through; a passage from one street or opening to another; an unobstructed way. 2. Power of passing.
